page.layout: One column of italic verse, in stanzas, with the running head above it. At the lower right, below the last line, the catchword "Quid".

l.i: Degener, & Musæ studium pellacis inane.
Me caligo nocens, tenebrisque horrentibus umbræ
Deseruere, tui primos ad luminis ortus.
Terra vale, pennis liquidum supra æthera longe
Auferor: en ventos pedibus & nubila calco.
Sat noctisque umbrisque datum est, pudet isse tot
annos Cæcum per tenebras, lucémque hausisse malignam
Pœnitet, heu! ægramque animam dolor iste perurit.
En igitur quà Religio caput extulit umbris,
Me juvet antiqui Musas super ardua Juræ
Sistere: jamque novum hic Helicona, hic quærere
laurus Hic alias edico, alias templa horrida rupes:
Meque sequi moneo dumos per & aspera saxa:
Vos ô vos casti Vates, sanctique Poetæ,
Quà via secta recens, & quô vix ulla priorum
Me trepidum incertumque viæ vestigia ducant;
Hæc via nunc tentanda, mihi Vigor igneus ille
Quà se aperit, Vigor omnipotens, qui lumine casto
Exhaurit mentes hominum, puráque relinquit.
Quà mihi sedat lux oculis clarissima, cæli
Munere, me procul ô sævis Pater eripe terris
Quæ passim innocuo justorum sanguine inundant;
Et quæ te contra flammas & in arma feruntur.
Crudelis patriæ jam longa oblivia potem,
Nec mihi chara trahant alio natalia mentem,
Dum sacra mi plenis evoluere carmina fusis
Est animus, medioque oculos jam tollere cælo.
Ac jam Pæonias paulum intermittere Musas
Cura sit, & docto scriptas in pulvere formas,
Formásque radiósque & pictum in pariete mundum.
Ergo pij Vates huc jam revocantor, & esto
Hac iter in cælum, pia quà modo semita feruet
Cursu alacri: hoc agite, hoc nobis via calle secanda:
Nam mihi mendaces quid nunc accedere lucos,

page.notes: The line "ortus." in the first stanza is followed by a stray printed dash; it is not transcribed. The bottom catchword "Quid" is set apart at the lower right and is therefore in the bottom margin, not in the text. Two words are doubtful: "pudet isse" (printed with a long-s-like form, read as "isse") and "hausisse" (printed "haufisse"). The verse is set in italic throughout, and the line breaks inside each stanza are kept.
